title: Lie action on linear maps between representations
statement: Let $k$ be a field [def-weil-field] and $L$ a $k$-Lie algebra [def-wf-lie-algebra]. Let $V,W$ be $k$-vector spaces with representations $\rho_V:L\to\operatorname{End}_k(V)$ and $\rho_W:L\to\operatorname{End}_k(W)$, meaning linear maps preserving brackets, where the bracket on endomorphisms is the commutator. Then the vector space $\operatorname{Hom}_k(V,W)$ of $k$-linear maps is a representation of $L$ with action $$(x\cdot f)(v)=\rho_W(x)(f(v))-f(\rho_V(x)(v)).$$ No finite-dimensionality assumption is imposed.
